sample.title: FERC Accepts PJM Reliability Backstop Proposal

meta.summary: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission on Sept. 29 issued an Order on PJM’s proposed Reliability Backstop Procurement (RBP) to secure additional power supply to address short-term reliability concerns. The Order (PDF) accepts PJM’s proposal but suspends it for five months with an effective date of Feb. 28, 2027, subject to refund and outcome of additional […]

sample.title: Over 600 Projects Enter Phase I of PJM’s New Interconnection Process

meta.summary: The first phase of PJM’s new interconnection process started Sept. 28, with 617 projects capable of generating nearly 169 GW of electricity remaining in the study Cycle. This marks the first group of proposed generation resources to be processed under a new approach designed to reduce speculative projects, improve predictability and increase the overall pace […]

sample.title: PJM Kicks Off Annual Process of Vetting Large Load Requests

meta.summary: PJM has begun its annual review of proposed Large Load adjustments to determine the impact to PJM’s 2027 Long-Term Load Forecast, using updated guidelines designed to better account for how likely proposed projects are to materialize. The review comes as electricity demand is growing rapidly across the PJM region, driven largely by data centers and […]

sample.title: PJM Membership Elects Janet Dietrich to Board of Managers

meta.summary: PJM Interconnection announced today that its Members have elected Janet Dietrich to the PJM Board of Managers. The process for electing Board members is set forth in the FERC-approved PJM Operating Agreement. sample.title: PJM Issues Maximum Generation Alert for Sept. 17

meta.summary: PJM has issued a Maximum Generation Alert and Load Management Alert for Sept. 17 ahead of unusually warm September weather and planned maintenance outages for both generation resources and transmission. sample.title: Reminder: PJM GridAdvance Summit One Month Away
